content: Ishaan Bose inquired about a 12% premium increase on his health insurance, which Sunita Agarwal explained was due to medical inflation and comprehensive coverage. Ishaan asked about early-renewal discounts and was informed he could get 5% off if renewing before 15/09. After comparing the standard renewal ($1,200/year) with the upgraded plan ($1,320/year with discount), Ishaan decided to proceed with the upgrade. Sunita agreed to send a secure payment link to complete the transaction.

action_items: Send secure payment link for the upgraded plan
